name: docforge
description: Repository documentation architect — generates a repo's full docs/ tree, README, ADRs, risk registers, and AI-agent context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/agents/), grounded in a knowledge-graph analysis of the source with git-hash provenance tracking.

plugins.name: docforge
plugins.description: Design and generate a repository's documentation set — docs/ tree, README, two-altitude architecture (high-level map, low-level detail, deep-dive concepts), tech-debt and constraints registers, decision records, dependency inventory, security policy, error catalogs, runbooks, AI-agent context files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/agents/), plus aligned per-flow documents and Business Analyst and Product Owner audience depth. Grounded in a knowledge-graph analysis of the actual source, with git-hash provenance so staleness is checked, not guessed. Host-neutral, with multi-repo collection discovery for diligence.
